annotations.title: chainpeek: list a wallet's live token approvals (ERC-20 and Permit2) with revoke transactions

description: chainpeek: List a wallet's live token approvals and get revoke transactions. For tokens already pulled out use check_wallet_drain; for one allowance use get_allowance. Returns the live ERC-20 and Permit2 allowances of `wallet`: amount or unlimited, spender code (key-controlled, contract, new contract), newest approval and pull, staleness, flags with evidence, and the unsigned revoke transaction that sets it to 0. Candidates: approval events in the latest 6,000 blocks, Permit2, and `spenders`. High: unlimited to a key-controlled account. Medium: limited to one, or unlimited to a contract with no code 30 days ago. Low: other unlimited or stale. Older approvals are found only via `spenders` or Permit2. Bad input is a 422, a failed read a 502 (neither charged). Nothing is signed or sent. Typically 3-15 s. Price: USD 0.005. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/token-approval-audit-api.html

chain.description: base or ethereum (the chains with built-in USDC and USDT here).

lookback_blocks.description: Latest blocks scanned for approval events (0-6,000; default 6,000, about 20 minutes on Base today and 20 hours on Ethereum; `history.from_time` says when the window starts). 0 scans nothing and checks `spenders` and Permit2 only.

spenders.description: Up to 50 spender addresses whose ERC-20 and Permit2 allowances are read directly on every audited token, however old (tokens x spenders at most 200). The full-coverage path for spenders you know.

stale_days.description: An allowance is stale when the spender pulled nothing from the wallet in this many days.

tokens.description: Up to 50 token contracts to audit. Default: USDC, USDT and up to 18 tokens the wallet has sent (from its transfer history).

wallet.description: The wallet whose approvals are audited (0x + 40 hex).

name: audit_token_approvals

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
